business_summary: Masco Corporation provides home improvement and building products in North America, Europe, and internationally. The company's Plumbing Products segment offers faucets, showerheads, handheld showers, valves, bath hardware and accessories, bathing units, shower bases and enclosures, shower drains, steam shower systems, water filtration systems, and sinks and kitchen accessories; acrylic tubs, bath and shower enclosures, and shower bases and trays; spas, exercise pools, and aquatic fitness systems and saunas; brass, copper, and composite plumbing system component and other non-decorative plumbing products; water products; and thermoplastic products, extruded plastic profiles, and specialized fabrication products, as well as PEX tubing products. This segment provides its products under the DELTA, BRIZO, PEERLESS, HANSGROHE, AXOR, KRAUS, NEWPORT BRASS, GINGER, WALTEC, BRISTAN, HERITAGE, MIROLIN, HOT SPRING, CALDERA, FREEFLOW SPAS, FANTASY SPAS, AQUATERRA, LIFESMART, ENDLESS POOLS, TYLO, FINNLEO, HELO, BRASSCRAFT, PLUMBSHOP, and MASTER PLUMBER brands, as well as under private label to home center and online retailers, mass merchandisers, wholesalers and distributors, plumbers, building contractors, remodelers, smaller retailers, and consumers and homebuilders. Its Decorative Architectural Products segment offers paints, primers, specialty coatings, stains, and waterproofing products, as well as paint applicators and accessories; cabinet and door hardware, functional hardware, hook and hook rail products, and outdoor living hardware; and decorative bath hardware, shower accessories, and shower doors. This segment provides its products under the BEHR, KILZ, WHIZZ, LIBERTY, and FRANKLIN BRASS brands to home center and other retailers, mass and online retailers, other specialty retailers, and original equipment manufacturers and wholesalers. The company was incorporated in 1929 and is headquartered in Livonia, Michigan.
business_summary_ko: Masco Corporation은 북미, 유럽 및 국제적으로 주택 개량 및 건축 제품을 제공합니다. 회사의 배관 제품 부문에서는 수도꼭지, 샤워헤드, 휴대용 샤워기, 밸브, 욕조 하드웨어 및 액세서리, 욕실 장치, 샤워 베이스 및 인클로저, 샤워 배수구, 스팀 샤워 시스템, 물 여과 시스템, 싱크대 및 주방 액세서리를 제공합니다. 아크릴 욕조, 욕조 및 샤워 인클로저, 샤워 베이스 및 트레이; 스파, 운동 수영장, 수중 피트니스 시스템 및 사우나; 황동, 구리, 복합 배관 시스템 부품 및 기타 비장식 배관 제품; 물 제품; 열가소성 제품, 압출 플라스틱 프로파일, 특수 제작 제품, PEX 튜빙 제품 등이 있습니다. 이 부문은 DELTA, BRIZO, PEERLESS, HANSGROHE, AXOR, KRAUS, NEWPORT BRASS, GINGER, WALTEC, BRISTAN, HERITAGE, MIROLIN, HOT SPRING, CALDERA, FREEFLOW SPAS, FANTASY SPAS, AQUATERRA, LIFESMART, ENDLESS POOLS, TYLO, FINNLEO, HELO, BRASSCRAFT, PLUMBSHOP 및 MASTER PLUMBER 브랜드는 물론 홈 센터 및 온라인 소매업체, 대량 판매업체, 도매업체 및 유통업체, 배관공, 건물에 대한 자체 브랜드 판매
